t: What Scientific Anomaly Registry Is All About
title: What Scientific Anomaly Registry Is All About
description: Anomalies are observations the current model can't explain — and they're where revolutions start. Mercury's orbit precessed 43 arcseconds per century more than Newton predicted; Einstein's relativity explained it exactly. The registry rule: log the anomaly with full evidence, rule out error first, and never bend the data to save the model. This database is the complete anomaly: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Scientific Anomaly Registry: a complete reference database of full anomaly records.
key_points: What this database holds: full anomaly records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

Every record is the full entry — never a stub or description alone.
Teaching ladder: Foundations first, then Compounded, then Advanced.

t: Core Vocabulary of Scientific Anomaly Registry
title: Core Vocabulary of Scientific Anomaly Registry
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Scientific Anomaly Registry — learn them first and every later record reads faster: anomaly: observation contradicting the current model; paradigm: the dominant explanatory framework; null hypothesis: default assumption the anomaly is error; replication: independent repeat of the observation.
definition: The working vocabulary of Scientific Anomaly Registry: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: anomaly: observation contradicting the current model
paradigm: the dominant explanatory framework
null hypothesis: default assumption the anomaly is error
replication: independent repeat of the observation
systematic error: consistent bias mimicking a signal
extraordinary evidence: proof bar scaling with claim strangeness
how_it_works: Read each term and definition twice.
Use three terms in a sentence of your own.
Quiz yourself with the demo program.
Add new terms as you meet them.
